info.description: The individual-based twin of the System dynamics library's SIR asset: 2000 Person agents, each a Susceptible/Infected/Recovered state machine. Infection is a SHARED rate beta * I / N (COUNT of the Infected state over the population) so every Susceptible agent's hazard tracks the current outbreak size; recovery is a per-agent EXPO(1/gamma) timeout. With beta=0.25, gamma=0.1 (R0=2.5) and 10 initial Infected, the final Recovered count converges to the classic final-size relation z = 1 - exp(-R0 z) as the population grows. Beta, gamma, the population and the initial Infected are this instance's own; the Outbreak preset fills beta and gamma from an illustrative catalogue.
